item.title: VoiceInk 2.21 (c09cc1f)
item.description:
VoiceInk 2.21 (c09cc1f)

  • Limit diagnostic log exports to the last 30 minutes (c09cc1f)
  • add onboarding skip and prioritize default model selection (d6960f3)
  • Play custom recording sounds at full volume (880502b)
  • Fix Return-to-send after custom command delivery (d4d718b)
  • Add AssemblyAI Universal 3.6 Pro support (4798ce0)
  • Add ElevenLabs Scribe V2 Medical support (f657a78)
  • Embed Swift standard libraries in app builds (0206b60)
  • Start diagnostic session at launch (e8f4dd0)
  • Ensure Parakeet models include required VAD files (7fdc5c3)
  • Bump version to 2.21 (36abef9)
  • Improve history playback accessibility and filter enhancement errors (44d3013)
  • Unify History and Quick History UI (76fa8be)
  • Fix Insights issues and remove productivity chart (3d14219)
  • Refine Insights design and simplify shared components (7881e3a)
  • Update enhancement defaults and AI model selections (ba16d14)
  • Add Parakeet Ultra support (593fadb)
  • Add voice activity detection to FluidAudio transcription (6985c4b)
  • Fix playback and mute restoration after recording (af772a8)
  • Reuse DictionaryPill for vocabulary and replacement chips (2ead93e)
  • Unify dictionary pills and merge replacement rules (d217463)
